title: The shop
content:
The shop

Eleven pairs and a shutter

We started in 2018 selling what we wanted to wear, and the shop has stayed that size on purpose.

2018

We buy what we would wear

There is no buying team. Two of us choose, and if neither would wear it, it does not go on the wall. That is why the shelf is short and why the same four shoes keep coming back.

  • One pair per customer on a drop, enforced at checkout
  • No resale bots: accounts older than a week only
  • Everything photographed on our own feet
Shop the shelf

Four steps

How the shelf is chosen

01

Choose

Two of us, a sample, and a rule: would we wear it out on a Tuesday?

02

Order

Small runs, paid up front, which is why a drop is 120 pairs and not 1,200.

03

Drop

Saturday at ten, one pair per customer, no restock on a colourway.

04

Keep

Free repairs on soles and eyelets for the first year.

title: FAQ
content:
Help

Questions we are asked most

Drops, sizing, delivery and keeping a pair alive.

Drops

Have an account before the day, be on the site at ten, and choose your size. It is first come, and a drop of 120 pairs usually lasts under four minutes.

By account and by card. A second order on the same drop is refunded, and repeat offenders lose the account.

No. A drop colourway is made once. The permanent colours, like Runner 2 Black, are always here.

Sizing

The Court is true from the box. Canvas is stiff for a week, then true. The mesh runner comes up small: go up half a size. Full measurements are on the size guide.

Yes, within 30 days, unworn, and we pay the postage both ways.

Delivery and returns

Orders before 2pm go out the same working day. Free over $90, otherwise $6.

From the shop, from noon on a drop day, or any opening hour after that.

Care

Cool water, a soft brush, no machine. The care kit has a pH-neutral cleaner that will not strip the dye.

Soles and eyelets, free in the first year. Bring them in or post them.

title: Delivery and returns
content:
Delivery and returns

How it gets to you, and back

Orders before 2pm go the same day. Drop orders go out on the Monday.

What it costs

Delivery

Standard delivery

$6, two to three working days

Free delivery

On orders over $90

Next day

$12, ordered before 2pm on a working day

Collection

Free, from the shop, noon on a drop day

Returns

Free for 30 days, unworn, in the box

Returns

Thirty days, unworn, in the original box, with the spare laces still in it. Start a return from your account and we send a label. Refunds land within three working days of the parcel reaching us.

Drops

A drop pair can be returned like anything else, but it goes back on sale rather than being restocked to you, so an exchange for a different size is not always possible.

Repairs

Soles and eyelets are repaired free in the first year. Beyond that we charge parts only. Bring them to the shop or post them with a note.
